name: R Systems International Limited
summary: R Systems International Limited, a digital product engineering company, designs and builds chip-to-cloud software products and platforms in Europe, the United States, and internationally. It provides information technology and business process outsourcing services. It also offers modernization solutions, such as legacy system and cloud modernization, hyper automation and managed services, and data and AI; and Cloud and DevOps solutions, including cloud migration and modernization, DevSecOps, CloudOps, FinOps, IoT, and AWS well-architected services; and chaos engineering integrated disaster recovery (DRaaS) models.
